set.body:
Source: https://github.com/bbuchsbaum/natural-features/issues/10
Outcome: optional audio.music.beat_activations extractor, FeatureSeries(time, feature) with beat/downbeat columns.
Proposed paths: new src/natural_features/features/audio/beat.py; audio/__init__.py; zoo/specs/core_extractors.yaml; pyproject.toml/uv.lock; tests/unit/test_beat_this_contracts.py; tests/external/test_real_music_backends.py; music cookbook and CHANGELOG.md.
API: AudioStimulus, checkpoint/local asset, device, local_files_only=True, strict execution. Resolve/check/hash cached assets before invoking backend; guard upstream download paths. Require explicit caller resampling to backend rate. Default output is sigmoid-transformed logits, described as activation scores, not calibrated confidence. Expose a documented logits option whose scale enters identity; no discrete events in initial scope.
Upstream checked 2026-10-06: Audio2Frames emits logits and otherwise resamples to 22050 Hz; its loader downloads on absent file. LogMelSpect uses hop 441 (50 Hz). Inference uses 1500-frame chunks, six-frame borders and keep_first aggregation. Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CPJKU/beat_this/main/beat_this/inference.py and https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CPJKU/beat_this/main/beat_this/preprocessing.py .
Validate supported preprocessing/version and frame count; derive timestamps from actual hop, centering, padding and crop rules. Record local frontend support plus chunk-specific bidirectional context, including extra overlap at the final chunk. Preserve clock/offset.
Acceptance: known logits map to analytic sigmoid values; logits may be unbounded while activations are finite in [0,1]; channels cannot swap; test first/last frame and transitions across chunk boundaries, short inputs, invalid rate, cache miss with no network, and phase-specific errors. Keep deterministic adapter tests separate from pinned-checkpoint direct-upstream parity on CPU.
Next action after contract: build fixture for spectrogram timing/chunk aggregation, then implement strict loader and adapter.
set.title: GitHub #10: add offline beat and downbeat activation adapter
